title: Check Good Number (Digit Greater than Right Sum)

content.problemStatement:
Good Number

Problem Statement

Given a digit an a range . Write a program to print all the good numbers between range and that do not contain given digit

Note: A good number is a number in which every digit is larger than the sum of digits of its right

Example: 9421 is a good number

          9 > (4+2+1)

          4 > (2+1)

          2 > 1
content.inputFormat: Input contains two values N1 and N2 and digit D
content.outputFormat: Print the Good numbers seperated by space which should not contain given digit

sampleTestCases.explanation: Input produces the expected output following problem rules.

solution.approach: Find all good numbers in range [L, R] that do not contain digit D.
solution.editorial: Iterate numbers in range, skip those with digit D, verify each digit exceeds sum of digits to its right.

hints: For each digit except last, ensure digit > sum of remaining digits.
